==Description==
The '''Goo''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[Trick or Threat Town]] as part of the [[Halloween 2020 Event]]. It did not appear naturally; instead, two '''Goos''' spawned when a [[Slime (Trick or Threat Town)|Slime]] died. It was the fastest enemy in the event, being a bit faster than the [[Witch (Trick or Threat Town)|Witch]]. It also had fairly high health, 200 more than the [[Hallow Bones]].

==Appearance==
The '''Goo''' was a completely lime green enemy. It was faceless. All of its body parts were encased in a slime capsule which was slightly translucent. It emitted goo particles from its body. It had an awkward running animation.

==Strategy==
*Since the '''Goo''' is quite fast, you may want to use the [[Electroshocker]], [[Freezer]] or [[Frost Blaster]] to slow it down.
*Because of the '''Goo's''' high speed, the [[Ranger]] paired with the [[DJ Booth]] can be quite useful against it, as the [[Ranger]] has a very long range.
**The [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability can also help against the '''Goo''', as the ability boosts the [[Ranger]]'s slow firerate.
***Setting your [[Ranger]]s to ''First'' is recommended for this, as they will target stronger enemies otherwise, leaving your base vulnerable.
*The [[Military Base]]'s [[Tank (Unit)|Tanks]] and [[Railgun Tank]]s are useful if the '''Goo''' outruns your towers.
**Do note that it can be expensive to upgrade the [[Military Base]] in [[Trick or Threat Town]].

==Trivia==
*The '''Goo''' is inspired by the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Goo|Goo]] from ''Tower Battles''.
